what: Ladder-bot decision: the self-play champion gen5 against DODUO-greedy, at two clock-sized budgets. Written 2026-09-25 BEFORE the first game of either arm.
team_store: data/team-pool-frozen-regmc (pool digest 792daded918f; games.bo3.jsonl a68263bb568d), TEST pairs, cycled (solver/mew/pairs.js)

x_arms.gen5-1s: solver/machamp/league/gen5.json (MILTANK, gen5 MAG/DODUO/PORYGON2, k 4x4, depth 0, 1 reserved switch row, budgetMs 1000)

y: solver/machamp/league/human-clone.json = DODUO-greedy: MAG v1 + DODUO v1, argmax legal joint, no search. This is ROTOM's `prior` policy (solver/rotom/policy.js: MAG v1 + DODUO v1 through the prior adapter).
test: solver/machamp/sprt.js: normal-approximation GSPRT on pair scores; elo0 0, elo1 +20, alpha 0.05, beta 0.05, max 2,000 games (1,000 pairs), index order, read once at the bound. H1 = gen5 is proven stronger at that budget. H0 = not stronger. No bound = INCONCLUSIVE.
flags: --workers 3 --cap 50 --team-store data/team-pool-frozen-regmc; one arm at a time (never more than 3 workers on the machine from this run)
reported_with_the_verdict: Wilson 95% on the counted games (conditional on the stop); per-decision wall-clock mean/p95/max of gen5; per-game sum of gen5 decision time; MILTANK prior-fallback share (search.js fallbackEmpty/fallbackSparse) and agent fallbacks; playouts per searched decision.
clock_safe_rule: An arm is clock-safe if no gen5 decision exceeds 55 s (the Reg M-C bo3 VGC Timer's Max Per Turn) and no game's summed gen5 decision time exceeds 420 s (Timer Starting, grace excluded), read from solver/rotom/clock.js's rule. A breach is reported by count; ROTOM's clock would cap the budget but the arena run does not.
caveat_declared_before: The budget is WALL-CLOCK. A live ladder run (ROTOM, main checkout) shares the machine, so a MILTANK decision's compute at a given budget depends on load. The prior-fallback share is the counter that shows how much of 'gen5' was actually its own DODUO prior.
